issues.description: The exercise requires students to "Create a constructor" for `Lecture` (implying it should be usable to instantiate a `Lecture` from client code), but the reference solution declares the `Lecture(...)` constructor with package-private visibility (no `public`). This can break or confuse usage from outside `de.tum.cit.ase` (and any tests expecting a public constructor).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public: `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... }`.
